title: glycine javanica var. longicauda
intro: Glycine javanica var. longicauda, commonly known as the Long-tailed Snake Vine, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Glycine javanica var. longicauda include its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce pain and fever. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
